translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Hongwu reign (1372), it was transferred to Yongshun's jurisdiction, with Huang Guzhong appointed native chief.

sentences.zh: 傳至黃甲，清順治四年，歸附。

translations.literal: Transmitted to Huang Jia; in the fourth year of Qing Shunzhi, he submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed to Huang Jia, who submitted in the fourth year of the Shunzhi reign (1647).

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，黃正乾納土。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Huang Zhengqian surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Yongzheng reign (1727), Huang Zhengqian surrendered his territory.

sentences.zh: 驢遲峒長官司，元屬思州。

translations.literal: Lüchi Dong native chief office; in Yuan subordinate to Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Lüchi Dong native chief office was under Sizhou during the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 明洪武五年，改屬永順司，以向迪踵為長官司。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Ming Hongwu, jurisdiction changed to Yongshun Commission, with Xiang Dizhong as native chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Hongwu reign (1372), it was transferred to Yongshun's jurisdiction, with Xiang Dizhong appointed native chief.

sentences.zh: 傳至向光胄，清順治四年，歸附。

translations.literal: Transmitted to Xiang Guangzhou; in the fourth year of Qing Shunzhi, he submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed to Xiang Guangzhou, who submitted in the fourth year of the Shunzhi reign (1647).

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，向錫爵納土。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Xiang Xijue surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Yongzheng reign (1727), Xiang Xijue surrendered his territory.

sentences.zh: 施溶溪長官司，元屬思州。

translations.literal: Shirong Creek native chief office; in Yuan subordinate to Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Shirong Creek native chief office was under Sizhou during the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 明初，改屬永順司，以汪良為長官司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming, jurisdiction changed to Yongshun Commission, with Wang Liang as native chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Ming, it was transferred to Yongshun's jurisdiction, with Wang Liang appointed native chief.

sentences.zh: 傳至汪世忠，清順治四年，歸附。

translations.literal: Transmitted to Wang Shizhong; in the fourth year of Qing Shunzhi, he submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed to Wang Shizhong, who submitted in the fourth year of the Shunzhi reign (1647).

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，汪文珂納土。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Wang Wenke surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Yongzheng reign (1727), Wang Wenke surrendered his territory.

sentences.zh: 白岩峒長官司，元屬葛蠻安撫司。

translations.literal: Baiyan Dong native chief office; in Yuan subordinate to Geman Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Baiyan Dong native chief office was under the Geman Pacification Commission during the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 明初，改屬永順司，以張那律為長官司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming, jurisdiction changed to Yongshun Commission, with Zhang Nalü as native chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Ming, it was transferred to Yongshun's jurisdiction, with Zhang Nalü appointed native chief.

sentences.zh: 傳至張四教，清順治四年，歸附。

translations.literal: Transmitted to Zhang Sijiao; in the fourth year of Qing Shunzhi, he submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed to Zhang Sijiao, who submitted in the fourth year of the Shunzhi reign (1647).

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，張宗略納土。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Zhang Zonglüe surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Yongzheng reign (1727), Zhang Zonglüe surrendered his territory.

sentences.zh: 田家峒長官司，明洪武三年，以田勝祖為長官司。

translations.literal: Tianjia Dong native chief office; in the third year of Ming Hongwu, Tian Shengzu was made native chief.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianjia Dong native chief office was established in the third year of the Hongwu reign (1370), with Tian Shengzu appointed native chief.

sentences.zh: 傳至田興祿，清順治四年，歸附。

translations.literal: Transmitted to Tian Xinglu; in the fourth year of Qing Shunzhi, he submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed to Tian Xinglu, who submitted in the fourth year of the Shunzhi reign (1647).

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，田藎臣納土。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Tian Jinchen surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Yongzheng reign (1727), Tian Jinchen surrendered his territory.

sentences.zh: 保靖宣慰司，亦唐溪州地。

translations.literal: Baojing Pacification Commission, also Tang Xizhou territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Baojing Pacification Commission occupied the same territory as Tang-era Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 宋曰保靜州。

translations.literal: In Song called Baojing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it was known as Baojing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元為保靖州安撫司。

translations.literal: In Yuan it was Baojing Prefecture Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it became the Baojing Prefecture Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 明仍為安撫使。

translations.literal: In Ming still Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming continued the office as Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 清順治四年，明宣慰司彭象乾之子彭朝柱歸附。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qing Shunzhi, Ming Pacification Commissioner Peng Xiangqian's son Peng Chaochu submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Shunzhi reign (1647), Peng Chaochu, son of the former Ming Pacification Commissioner Peng Xiangqian, submitted.

sentences.zh: 象乾曾孫澤虹病廢，其妻彭氏用事。

translations.literal: Xiangqian's great-grandson Zehong was disabled by illness, his wife Lady Peng wielded power.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangqian's great-grandson Zehong was incapacitated by illness, and his wife, Lady Peng, held the real power.

sentences.zh: 漢奸高倫、張為任二人結連其舍把長官彭澤蛟、彭祖裕等，相與樹黨，以劫殺為事。

translations.literal: Han traitors Gao Lun and Zhang Weiren two men colluded with his sheba chiefs Peng Zejiao, Peng Zuyu and others, together forming factions, making robbery and killing their business.
translations.idiomatic: Two Han collaborators, Gao Lun and Zhang Weiren, allied with his subordinate chiefs Peng Zejiao, Peng Zuyu, and others, forming rival factions that lived by robbery and murder.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，澤虹死，子御彬幼，澤蛟欲奪其職，為禦彬所遏。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, Zehong died, son Yubin young, Zejiao wished to seize his office, was blocked by Yubin.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Yongzheng reign (1723), Zehong died, leaving a young heir, Yubin. Zejiao sought to seize the office but was thwarted by Yubin.

sentences.zh: 迨御彬襲職，肆為淫凶，澤蛟與其弟澤虬合謀，互相劫殺。

translations.literal: When Yubin succeeded to office, he indulged in licentiousness and cruelty; Zejiao and his younger brother Zeqiu plotted together, mutually robbing and killing.
translations.idiomatic: Once Yubin inherited the office, he ruled with unrestrained brutality. Zejiao and his younger brother Zeqiu plotted together, and the two sides raided and killed one another.

sentences.zh: 二年，御彬以追緝澤蛟為名，潛結容美土司田旻如、桑植土司向國棟，率土兵搶虜保靖民財。

translations.literal: In the second year, Yubin under the pretext of pursuing Zejiao, secretly allied with Rongmei native prefect Tian Minru and Sangzhi native prefect Xiang Guodong, leading native troops to plunder Baojing people's property.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (1724), Yubin, claiming he was hunting Zejiao, secretly allied with Rongmei chieftain Tian Minru and Sangzhi chieftain Xiang Guodong, leading native troops to loot the people of Baojing.

sentences.zh: 七年，御彬安置遼陽，以其地為保靖縣。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Yubin was resettled in Liaoyang, its territory made Baojing County.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of the Yongzheng reign (1729), Yubin was resettled in Liaoyang, and his territory was reorganized as Baojing County.

sentences.zh: 大喇司，在龍山縣，屬保靖司。

translations.literal: Dala office, in Longshan County, subordinate to Baojing Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Dala office lay in Longshan County under the Baojing Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 明正德十五年，以土舍彭惠協理巡檢事。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Ming Zhengde, native sub-official Peng Hui was assigned to assist in managing inspection affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of the Zhengde reign (1520), the native sub-official Peng Hui was appointed to assist in patrol and inspection duties.

sentences.zh: 傳至彭禦佶，雍正十三年，納土。

translations.literal: Transmitted to Peng Yuji; in the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed to Peng Yuji, who surrendered his territory in the thirteenth year of the Yongzheng reign (1735).

sentences.zh: 桑植宣慰司，本慈利縣地。

translations.literal: Sangzhi Pacification Commission, originally Cili County territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Sangzhi Pacification Commission occupied land that had once belonged to Cili County.

sentences.zh: 元有上桑植、下桑植宣慰司。

translations.literal: In Yuan there were Upper Sangzhi and Lower Sangzhi Pacification Commissions.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan there had been separate Upper and Lower Sangzhi pacification commissions.

sentences.zh: 明置安撫司。

translations.literal: Ming established Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming consolidated the office into a single pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 清順治四年，宣慰司向鼎歸附，授原職。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qing Shunzhi, Pacification Commissioner Xiang Ding submitted, granted his original office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Shunzhi reign (1647), Pacification Commissioner Xiang Ding submitted and was confirmed in his former office.

sentences.zh: 鼎子長庚調鎮古州八萬。

translations.literal: Ding's son Chang Geng was transferred to garrison Guzhou and Bawan.
translations.idiomatic: Ding's son Chang Geng was transferred to command the garrison at Guzhou and Bawan.

sentences.zh: 長庚子向國棟殘虐，與容美、永順、茅岡各土司相仇殺，民不堪命。

translations.literal: Chang Geng's son Xiang Guodong was brutal and cruel, with Rongmei, Yongshun, Maogang various native prefects mutually feuding and killing, the people could not bear their fate.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Geng's son Xiang Guodong ruled with vicious cruelty, feuding and killing with the chieftains of Rongmei, Yongshun, Maogang, and others until the people could endure no more.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，土經歷唐宗聖與國棟弟國柄等相率赴愬，總督傅敏入奏，乃繳追印篆，國棟安置河南，以其地為桑植縣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng, native director Tang Zongsheng and Guodong's younger brother Guobing and others together led a petition, Governor-General Fu Min memorialized the throne, then the seal was surrendered and recovered, Guodong resettled in Henan, its territory made Sangzhi County.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Yongzheng reign (1726), the native director Tang Zongsheng led Guodong's younger brother Guobing and others to lodge a collective complaint. Governor-General Fu Min memorialized the court, the commission seal was confiscated, Guodong was resettled in Henan, and the territory was reorganized as Sangzhi County.

sentences.zh: 上下峒長官司，明置宣撫司，復改為長官司，而分其地為二。

translations.literal: Upper and Lower Dong native chief offices; Ming established Pacification Commission, again changed to native chief offices, and divided its territory in two.
translations.idiomatic: The upper and lower dong native chief offices had been a single pacification commission under the Ming, later reduced to chief offices with the land split in two.

sentences.zh: 清康熙二年，向九鸞、向日葵歸附。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qing Kangxi, Xiang Jiuluan and Xiang Rikui submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Kangxi reign (1663), Xiang Jiuluan and Xiang Rikui submitted.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，給九鸞上峒長官司印，日葵下峒長官司印。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, Jiuluan was given Upper Dong native chief seal, Rikui Lower Dong native chief seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year (1682), Jiuluan received the seal of upper-dong native chief, and Rikui the seal of lower-dong native chief.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年，上峒司向玉衡、下峒司向良佐納土，以其地屬桑植縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, Upper Dong Commissioner Xiang Yuheng and Lower Dong Commissioner Xiang Liangzuo surrendered the land, its territory belonging to Sangzhi County.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of the Yongzheng reign (1735), Upper Dong chief Xiang Yuheng and Lower Dong chief Xiang Liangzuo surrendered their territories, which were placed under Sangzhi County.

sentences.zh: 茅岡長官司，明改天平千戶所。

translations.literal: Maogang native chief office; Ming changed to Tianping Guard post.
translations.idiomatic: The Maogang native chief office had been reorganized under the Ming as the Tianping Guard post.

sentences.zh: 清順治四年，石門天平所千戶覃祚昌、茅岡長官覃廕祚等相繼歸附，給與印信。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qing Shunzhi, Shimen Tianping Guard commander Qin Zuochang, Maogang native chief Qin Yinzuo and others successively submitted, granted seals and credentials.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Shunzhi reign (1647), Qin Zuochang, commander of the Tianping Guard at Shimen, and Maogang chief Qin Yinzuo submitted in turn and received official seals.

sentences.zh: 雍正十二年，茅岡土司覃純一納土，石門天平所、慈利麻寮所相繼請設流官，分其地屬石門、慈利、安福三縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Yongzheng, Maogang native prefect Qin Chunyi surrendered the land; Shimen Tianping Guard, Cili Maliao Guard successively requested establishment of regular officials, dividing its territory belonging to Shimen, Cili, Anfu three counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of the Yongzheng reign (1734), Maogang chieftain Qin Chunyi surrendered his territory. The Tianping Guard at Shimen and the Maliao Guard in Cili then petitioned for regular officials, and the land was divided among Shimen, Cili, and Anfu counties.
